approved_scope: EV same-duration/request continuous incentive input and dose-response prediction, curved shapes allowed; no forced linearity/monotonicity
runtime: B1算法; historical discrete effects retained as explicit comparison and compatibility
method: Kennedy continuous DR pseudo-outcome plus Gaussian local-linear smoothing; reuse RIDE method idea, generalize domain, strict user cross-fitting and support checks
interpretation: population mean response and contrast relative to declared reference incentive at one common pre-fixed task; not individual future response or within-event changing price
incentive: pre-notice offered compensation rate; caller must declare unit; not realized payout
support: continuous observations, at least20 unique incentive values; no bridging holes or extrapolation; pure seven-arm data kept in discrete API
inference: conditional user multiplier sampling band only; smoothing bias and nuisance/reference/process uncertainty not certified
task_duration: positive user-defined duration with complete aligned meter bins; existing reference model still restricted to its trained time window

comparators: straight line on same adjusted pseudo-outcome

not_in_scope: new task negotiation or changing task length after incentive
